prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop web dashboard screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: a completely new D2K router control panel, direction "Домашний пульт", polished shippable product UI inspired by the precise front panel of quality domestic electronics. This is a functional interface screenshot, not a poster or promotional landing page.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing D2K radar logo, preserve its identity and use once at 36px beside D2K. Image 2 is the approved D2K router robot mascot; preserve it, show only as a small 95px support illustration in the lower sidebar, never a hero.
Composition: entire viewport filled with UI, no browser chrome, no perspective or device frame. Narrow left navigation 190px wide, main content across remaining width. Header top with "Обзор" and right small "Демонстрационные данные". Compact dark navy status band spanning main area, below it light slate left list column (two thirds width), compact right controls column (one third). Grid aligned, functional white space, 32px outer gutters, 12px radii, extremely subtle borders. Never a giant hero.
Palette: soft light slate #F5F7FA, navy #182C3C, deep restrained blue #186E9A, pale bluegray #D9E6EC, teal small status indicators. Crisp sophisticated sans-serif Russian typography and monospace domains.
Sidebar: D2K radar logo and D2K wordmark. Nav "Обзор" selected, then "Подборы", "Семейства", "Журнал", "Настройки". Small mascot at lower left with caption "Dynamic2Keenetic".
Status band: small green dot plus "Движок включён" in confident 27px type, secondary "Обход применяется автоматически". Right two small inline states "Контроллер подключён" and "Состояние обновлено". No claim that internet accessibility is checked.
Main left section title "Сейчас подбирается" with small count 2. Clean flat rows: "meduza.io" with chips "TLS 1.3" "IPv4" and state "Проверяем обход", subordinate "Проверено вариантов: 2", subtle steps line "Замер → Подбор → Проверка"; second row "rutracker.org" with chips "TLS 1.2" "IPv4", state "Изучаем соединение", subordinate "Проверено вариантов: 0". Chevron for details each.
Below title "Сохранённые семейства" small secondary "Новые адреса используют найденный обход". Search field "Найти домен". A compact beautiful list/table: googlevideo.com | QUIC · IPv4 | "Обход сохранён"; googlevideo.com | TLS 1.3 · IPv6 | "Обход сохранён"; cdninstagram.com | TLS 1.3 · IPv4 | "Обход сохранён"; youtube.com | TLS 1.2 · IPv4 | "Обход сохранён". Each row with small neutral protocol icon and expand chevron, no huge cards, no individual CDN-host duplicates.
Right column top "Управление" with two large practical buttons "Остановить D2K" outlined and "Перезапустить" subdued, helper "Сохранённые обходы останутся". Below separate white bordered block "Telegram-туннель" with small green dot "Подключён", paragraph "Работает независимо от движка", compact button "Выключить туннель". Below quiet "О панели" with "Данные обновляются автоматически" and "Доступность сайтов не проверяется".
Constraints: accurate readable Russian text, realistic generous tappable controls, tangible restrained premium feel. No traffic charts, no invented speed tests or latency numbers, no security guarantee, no neon glow beyond pre-existing logo/mascot art, no gradients in main UI, no glassmorphism, no giant mascot, no marketing headline. Demonstration data label mandatory.
